note: 416 verified manufacturer/type/color combinations from the US Bambu Lab store product variants and Cookiecad shop/color matrix. Includes sold-out listings. Bundles, packaging and spool/refill duplicates excluded. Preview swatches approximate appearance. Catalog listings do not validate spool geometry or configure printing material presets. Amolen entries are limited to 1 kg spools for the initial profile. Sunlu entries are the 1 kg rolls from the US Sunlu store (store.sunlu.com), including sold-out colors; refill coils, 3 kg/5 kg large spools, 250 g minis and 0.8–0.9 kg rolls are excluded. Sunlu 1 kg spools use the Bambu Lab clip fit (owner-tested). Jayo entries are the 1.1 kg rolls on Jayo's reusable plastic spool from the US Jayo store (store.jayo3d.com), including sold-out colors (Jayo ABS comes as 1 kg); cardboard-spool, transparent-spool, 5 kg, bundle and multi-roll listings are excluded. Jayo reusable spools use the Bambu Lab clip fit (owner-tested). Some long Bambu Lab, Cookiecad and Amolen names are shortened so they print in full on the clip; the manufacturer's original names are kept as label_aliases, so CSVs that use them still import. Polymaker and Panchroma entries are the 1 kg, 1.75 mm spools from the US Polymaker store (shop.polymaker.com), including sold-out colors; Panchroma lines are listed under the Panchroma name and all other Polymaker lines under Polymaker. Refills, 0.5/0.75/2/3/5 kg spools, 2.85 mm, bundles and multi-roll packs are excluded. Where a color exists in both old and new packaging or formula, only one entry is kept (the new one). Panchroma Matte PLA colors beyond the store feed's cutoff were taken from the product page and have no SKU.
